## Fixes

- `agentport setup` and `agentport upgrade` no longer refuse a valid release
  with "attestation was made for repository \"https://github.com/RafaelB13/agentport\",
  not \"rafaelb13/agentport\"". The repository in the build attestation is now
  compared case-insensitively, as GitHub treats owner and repository names.
- The install scripts apply the same comparison.

If `agentport setup` failed with that message, reinstall with the install
script or `brew upgrade agentport`, then run `agentport setup` again.
